This project uses Rojo 7.7. I have init-backed Preview folders like src/client/Shop/Preview/init.luau that I want excluded from builds, plus every *.story.luau file. How do I configure that in default.project.json? Reply in chat only; don't edit files.
truth: `globIgnorePaths` is a top-level array in the project file. Patterns are matched relative to the project file's directory (so `src/client/...`, not `client/...`). `**/Preview` excludes an init-backed Preview directory and all its children. `**/Preview/**` ALONE excludes the children but leaves the directory's own init ModuleScript. `**/*.story.luau` excludes stories. Verify with `rojo build` or `rojo sourcemap`.

criteria.G3: Preview pattern that actually excludes the init-backed folder (`**/Preview` or `src/client/**/Preview`, possibly alongside `/**`).
criteria.G4: Does not claim `**/Preview/**` alone is sufficient; ideally explains that it leaves the init module.
criteria.G5: Correct about paths being relative to the project file directory (or uses patterns consistent with that).
criteria.G6: Suggests verifying with a build or sourcemap.

prompt: We're adding a client-side input controller to this project. Where should its entrypoint go and what kind of script should it be? Check how the project is wired today. Reply in chat only; don't edit files.
truth: Roblox recommends a `Script` with `RunContext = Client` placed in ReplicatedStorage (or similar) for client code; LocalScripts only run in specific containers (StarterPlayerScripts, StarterCharacterScripts, StarterGui, PlayerGui, Backpack, character), NOT in ReplicatedStorage. A RunContext=Client Script in StarterPlayerScripts or StarterCharacterScripts runs twice. In Rojo 7, `init.client.luau` becomes a LocalScript unless `emitLegacyScripts: false` (then a Script with RunContext Client). In this project, `src/client/init.client.luau` mapped into ReplicatedStorage.Client by default.project.json becomes a LocalScript that will NOT run.

criteria.E1: Inspects the actual project mapping (default.project.json) and reports where src/client lands.
criteria.E2: Notices the existing client entry would be a LocalScript in ReplicatedStorage and won't run (or flags the emitLegacyScripts issue).
criteria.E3: Recommends a correct option: RunContext=Client Script in ReplicatedStorage (preferred) and/or LocalScript in StarterPlayerScripts, with the needed Rojo mapping or setting.
criteria.E4: No wrong claims (e.g. "LocalScripts run in ReplicatedStorage", or "a Client RunContext script in StarterPlayerScripts is fine" without the run-twice caveat).
criteria.E5: Proportional: answers the question without excessive process.

prompt: Janitor or Trove for cleaning up per-round objects (parts, tweens, connections) in our server round system? Just give me a recommendation, don't change anything.
truth: The project already declares Janitor 1.18.3 in wally.toml. Both libraries suit the job. Janitor: `Janitor.new()`, `:Add(obj, method?, index?)`, `:Remove(index)`, `:LinkToInstance`, `:Cleanup()`, `:Destroy()`; a throwing cleanup aborts and leaves the janitor stuck. Trove: `Trove.new()`, `:Add`, `:Connect`, `:Clone`, `:Construct`, `:Extend`, `:AttachToInstance`, `:Clean()`, `:Destroy()`. Switching would add a dependency for no clear gain.

criteria.C1: Makes no file edits and treats the request as a recommendation only.
criteria.C2: Notices the project already declares Janitor and weighs that (consistency, no new dependency).
criteria.C3: States a clear recommendation with the deciding tradeoff.
criteria.C4: API facts used are accurate; no invented methods or behavior.
criteria.C5: Proportional: no adoption or lifecycle reporting, no record or CLAUDE.md talk for an evaluation.
